summary: ATS Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing the dates for its first quarter fiscal 2026 results conference call and its Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The release provides logistics for the August 6, 2026 earnings call and virtual annual meeting, referencing the Management Information Circular for meeting details. This is a routine scheduling announcement with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or corporate actions. The filing is purely administrative and informational.
